name: agentik-windows-control
description: Tool set for controlling Windows PC from Android via Agentik Hybrid system

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command on the Windows host (dir, notepad, git, pip, etc.)

command.description: The command to run, e.g. 'dir C:\\', 'notepad notes.txt'

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories under a given path

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file from Windows to Android

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch an installed application on Windows

tools.name: get_desktop_stream
tools.description: Get VNC stream URL for remote desktop control
